Devayāniyo.g: pāṭiyekko3 devalokagamanamaggo nāma natthi, iddhividhañāṇasseva panetaṁ adhivacanaṁ.

Devayāniyamaggoti.g: idaṁ Pāḷiyaṁ, Aṭṭhakathāsu ca tattha tattha āgataruḷhivasena vuttaṁ.

Devayāniyamaggoti.l: Devayāniyamaggoti vā -pa- abhiññāñāṇanti vā sabbametaṁ iddhividhañāṇasseva nāman
Devayāniyamaggoti.g: idaṁ Pāḷiyaṁ, Aṭṭhakathāsu ca tattha tattha āgataruḷhināmavasena vuttaṁ.
